scope: 28 new bespoke Pants and Leggings subcategory photographs with the shared atmosphere treatment. The existing parent and Corduroy Pants campaign images are retained. All 30 Pants and Leggings pages use bespoke campaign hero imagery. Existing product photography, Corduroy availability disclosure and all other page content outside the campaign note are unchanged.
artDirection: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one bespoke wide photographic hero for the WOW Fashion women's Pants and Leggings collection website, matching its premium warm editorial campaign. Create ONE finished photograph, horizontal 16:9 landscape, ideally 1672 by 941 pixels. Authentic natural fashion photography, lifelike skin, refined lens quality, realistic fabric texture, anatomically correct hands and believable garment construction. Show one adult woman on the RIGHT side, centred near 77 percent of the image width. Frame her complete figure, entire head with comfortable space above, and shoes with space beneath. Clearly show the entire waistband, leg shape and hem of the featured trousers or leggings; tops must be tucked or short enough that the rise remains visible. The LEFT 55 percent is quiet low-contrast warm pale limestone or plaster, unobstructed and ready for dark website headlines. Architecture, foliage and props stay mostly at the far right. Warm cream and pale stone surroundings, gentle flattering light, natural posture and realistic fabric movement. No text, letters, typography, logos, watermarks, UI, product labels, graphic gradients, smoke or artificial fog. The website adds its animated bottom blend later. Make this an original fashion campaign in a real setting, not an isolated catalogue cutout. Specific garment and scene:

assets.subject: An adult Black woman with natural shoulder-length curls wearing plain opaque matte black ankle-length leggings with a smooth high waistband, a softly fitted ivory short-sleeve tee tucked neatly at the waist and white minimal trainers. Her stance is relaxed, one foot gently forward, both legs and the ankle hems clearly visible. She stands on a pale stone café terrace in diffuse morning light, understated everyday styling.
assets.alt: Campaign inspiration: a woman wearing black leggings and an ivory tee on a pale stone terrace
